title: Chapter 19 — Pro Ranges and Luxury Cooking
intro: The 36-to-60-inch universe, dual fuel, and selling performance honestly.

sections.title: The Professional Range Market
sections.content:
Professional-style ranges start at 36 inches and go to 60 inches. They offer higher BTU output, larger oven cavities, commercial-grade construction, and serious cooking performance.

Dual fuel — gas burners with an electric oven — is the premium configuration. It combines the instant heat control of gas with the precise, even baking of electric convection.

These products require dedicated gas lines, higher-amperage electrical circuits, and commercial-grade ventilation. Know the infrastructure requirements.

sections.title: Selling Performance Honestly
sections.content:
Professional ranges are aspirational purchases. Many buyers cook casually but want a professional kitchen. That is perfectly fine — sell the experience and the design, not just the BTUs.

But never oversell capability. If someone asks whether they need a 48-inch range and they cook three times a week for two people, be honest. The 36-inch might serve them better. Honesty builds the trust that brings them back for the next kitchen.

sections.title: Coaching Rule
sections.content:
When evaluating pro range knowledge, ask:

Does the salesperson understand infrastructure requirements — gas, electrical, ventilation?
Do they sell honestly based on the customer's actual cooking habits?
Can they explain dual fuel and its advantages clearly?
Do they coordinate with contractors on installation requirements?
